class.name: FmodServer
class.brief_description: Main FMOD integration singleton providing audio system management.
class.description:
FmodServer is the core singleton class that manages the FMOD Studio API integration. It provides access to the FMOD audio system, manages banks, events, buses, and listeners. This class handles the initialization and configuration of the FMOD audio engine within Godot.
Use [code]FmodServer.get_singleton()[/code] to access the instance from GDScript.
The server manages: - Audio event creation and playback - Bank loading and management - 3D audio listener configuration - Global audio parameters - Performance monitoring - Plugin loading

method.name: add_listener
method.description: Adds a listener at the specified index attached to the given node. FMOD supports up to 8 listeners for 3D audio positioning.

method.name: banks_still_loading
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there are still banks being loaded asynchronously.

method.name: check_bus_guid
method.description: Checks if a bus with the specified GUID exists in the loaded banks.

method.name: check_bus_path
method.description: Checks if a bus with the specified path exists in the loaded banks.

method.name: check_event_guid
method.description: Checks if an event with the specified GUID exists in the loaded banks.

method.name: check_event_path
method.description: Checks if an event with the specified path exists in the loaded banks.

method.name: check_vca_guid
method.description: Checks if a VCA (Volume Control Automation) with the specified GUID exists in the loaded banks.

method.name: check_vca_path
method.description: Checks if a VCA with the specified path exists in the loaded banks.

method.name: create_event_instance
method.description: Creates a new instance of the specified FMOD event. The event path should be in the format "event:/path/to/event".

method.name: create_event_instance_from_description
method.description: Creates a new event instance from an existing [FmodEventDescription].

method.name: create_event_instance_with_guid
method.description: Creates a new instance of the FMOD event identified by its GUID.

method.name: create_sound_instance
method.description: Creates an instance of a loaded sound file for playback.

method.name: get_all_banks
method.description: Returns an array of all loaded [FmodBank] objects.

method.name: get_all_buses
method.description: Returns an array of all available [FmodBus] objects from loaded banks.

method.name: get_all_event_descriptions
method.description: Returns an array of all available [FmodEventDescription] objects from loaded banks.

method.name: get_all_vca
method.description: Returns an array of all available [FmodVCA] objects from loaded banks.

method.name: get_available_drivers
method.description: Returns an array of available audio drivers on the system.

method.name: get_bus
method.description: Gets the bus at the specified path. Bus paths follow the format "bus:/path/to/bus".

method.name: get_bus_from_guid
method.description: Gets the bus with the specified GUID.

method.name: get_driver
method.description: Returns the index of the currently selected audio driver.

method.name: get_event
method.description: Gets the event description at the specified path. Event paths follow the format "event:/path/to/event".

method.name: get_event_from_guid
method.description: Gets the event description with the specified GUID.

method.name: get_event_guid
method.description: Returns the GUID for the event at the specified path.

method.name: get_event_path
method.description: Returns the path for the event with the specified GUID.

method.name: get_godot_audio_bus
method.description: Returns the Godot audio bus FMOD's output plays on, or an empty string when FMOD plays to the audio device. See [member FmodGeneralSettings.output_routing].

method.name: get_global_parameter_by_id
method.description: Gets the value FMOD uses for a global parameter, by its ID. FMOD computes it on each [method FmodServer.update] from the value set from code and what FMOD Studio applies to the parameter: automatic parameters such as distance, automation, modulation and seek speed. A value set from code shows up after the next update. [method get_global_parameter_user_value_by_id] gives the value set from code.

method.name: get_global_parameter_by_name
method.description: Gets the value FMOD uses for a global parameter, by its name. FMOD computes it on each [method FmodServer.update] from the value set from code and what FMOD Studio applies to the parameter: automatic parameters such as distance, automation, modulation and seek speed. A value set from code shows up after the next update. [method get_global_parameter_user_value_by_name] gives the value set from code.

method.name: get_global_parameter_desc_by_id
method.description: Gets the description dictionary for a global parameter by its ID.

method.name: get_global_parameter_desc_by_name
method.description: Gets the description dictionary for a global parameter by its name.

method.name: get_global_parameter_desc_count
method.description: Returns the number of global parameters available.

method.name: get_global_parameter_desc_list
method.description: Returns an array of all global parameter descriptions.

method.name: get_global_parameter_user_value_by_id
method.description: Gets the value set from code for a global parameter, by its ID, or its default value when code never set one. Unlike the value FMOD uses, it ignores automatic parameters, automation, modulation and seek speed.

method.name: get_global_parameter_user_value_by_name
method.description: Gets the value set from code for a global parameter, by its name, or its default value when code never set one. Unlike the value FMOD uses, it ignores automatic parameters, automation, modulation and seek speed.

method.name: get_listener_2d_velocity
method.description: Returns the velocity of the listener at [param index], in pixels per second.

method.name: get_listener_3d_velocity
method.description: Returns the velocity of the listener at [param index], in meters per second.

method.name: get_listener_lock
method.description: Returns whether the listener at the specified index is locked (position won't be updated automatically).

method.name: get_listener_number
method.description: Returns the number of listeners FMOD mixes for.

method.name: get_listener_transform2d
method.description: Gets the 2D transform of the listener at the specified index.

method.name: get_listener_transform3d
method.description: Gets the 3D transform of the listener at the specified index.

method.name: get_listener_weight
method.description: Returns the weight of the listener at [param index], between 0 and 1.

method.name: get_object_attached_to_listener
method.description: Returns the node whose transform the listener at [param index] follows, or null when none is attached.

method.name: get_performance_data
method.description: Returns performance data for the FMOD system including CPU and memory usage.

method.name: get_system_dsp_buffer_length
method.description: Returns the length of FMOD's DSP buffers, in samples.

method.name: get_system_dsp_buffer_settings
method.description: Returns FMOD's current DSP buffer settings.

method.name: get_system_dsp_num_buffers
method.description: Returns the number of DSP buffers FMOD's mixer uses.

method.name: get_vca
method.description: Gets the VCA at the specified path. VCA paths follow the format "vca:/path/to/vca".

method.name: get_vca_from_guid
method.description: Gets the VCA with the specified GUID.

method.name: init
method.description: Initializes the FMOD system with the specified settings. This must be called before using any FMOD functionality.

method.name: is_plugin_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the plugin with the handle [method load_plugin] returned is loaded.

method.name: load_bank
method.description: Loads an FMOD bank file from the specified path. The flag parameter controls loading behavior (synchronous, asynchronous, etc.).

method.name: load_file_as_music
method.description: Loads an audio file for music playback with streaming optimizations.

method.name: load_file_as_sound
method.description: Loads an audio file as a sound effect with full loading into memory.

method.name: load_plugin
method.description: Loads the FMOD plugin library at [param plugin_path], with the given [param priority], and returns its handle. Plugins declared in [FmodPluginsSettings] are loaded at startup. Not available on iOS, which links plugins statically.

method.name: mixer_resume
method.description: Resumes FMOD's mixer after [method mixer_suspend]. The FMOD manager calls it when a mobile game regains focus.

method.name: mixer_suspend
method.description: Suspends FMOD's mixer, releasing the audio device. The FMOD manager calls it when a mobile game loses focus.

method.name: mute_all_events
method.description: Mutes all currently playing events.

method.name: pause_all_events
method.description: Pauses all currently playing events.

method.name: play_one_shot
method.description: Plays a one-shot event with no position attachment. The event must be marked as one-shot in FMOD Studio.

method.name: play_one_shot_attached
method.description: Plays a one-shot event attached to a specific node for 3D positioning.

method.name: play_one_shot_attached_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot event attached to a node with initial parameter values.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_event_description
method.description: Plays a one-shot instance of the event of [param event_description], released once it ends.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_event_description_attached
method.description: Plays a one-shot instance of the event of [param event_description], following [param game_obj]'s position until it ends.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_event_description_attached_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot instance of the event of [param event_description] with the parameter values of [param parameters], following [param game_obj]'s position until it ends.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_event_description_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot instance of the event of [param event_description], with the parameter values of [param parameters] (name to value).

method.name: play_one_shot_using_guid
method.description: Plays a one-shot instance of the event with the GUID [param guid], released once it ends.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_guid_attached
method.description: Plays a one-shot instance of the event with the GUID [param guid], following [param game_obj]'s position until it ends.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_guid_attached_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot instance of the event with the GUID [param guid] with the parameter values of [param parameters], following [param game_obj]'s position until it ends.

method.name: play_one_shot_using_guid_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot instance of the event with the GUID [param guid], with the parameter values of [param parameters] (name to value).

method.name: play_one_shot_with_params
method.description: Plays a one-shot event with initial parameter values.

method.name: remove_listener
method.description: Removes the listener at the specified index that was attached to the given node.

method.name: set_driver
method.description: Sets the audio driver to use by its index.

method.name: set_global_parameter_by_id
method.description: Sets the value of a global parameter by its ID.

method.name: set_global_parameter_by_id_with_label
method.description: Sets a global parameter by its ID using a labeled value (for enum parameters).

method.name: set_global_parameter_by_name
method.description: Sets the value of a global parameter by its name.

method.name: set_global_parameter_by_name_with_label
method.description: Sets a global parameter by its name using a labeled value (for enum parameters).

method.name: set_listener_lock
method.description: Sets whether the listener at the specified index is locked (position won't be updated automatically).

method.name: set_listener_number
method.description: Sets the number of listeners FMOD mixes for, between 1 and 8.

method.name: set_listener_transform2d
method.description: Sets the 2D transform of the listener at the specified index.

method.name: set_listener_transform3d
method.description: Sets the 3D transform of the listener at the specified index.

method.name: set_listener_weight
method.description: Sets the weight of the listener at [param index], between 0 and 1: how much it contributes to the mix when there are several.

method.name: set_software_format
method.description: Applies the sample rate, speaker mode and raw speaker count of [param settings] to FMOD's mixer. It must be called before FMOD initializes, which applies the Project Settings ones.

method.name: set_sound_3d_settings
method.description: Applies the doppler scale, distance factor and rolloff scale of [param settings] to FMOD's 3D audio.

method.name: set_system_dsp_buffer_size
method.description: Applies the DSP buffer length and count of [param dsp_settings] to FMOD's mixer. FMOD applies the Project Settings ones when it initializes.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Shuts down the FMOD system and releases all resources.

method.name: unload_file
method.description: Releases the sound file loaded from [param path] by [method load_file_as_sound] or [method load_file_as_music].

method.name: unload_plugin
method.description: Unloads the plugin with the handle [method load_plugin] returned.

method.name: unmute_all_events
method.description: Unmutes all currently muted events.

method.name: unpause_all_events
method.description: Unpauses all currently paused events.

method.name: update
method.description: Updates the FMOD system. This should be called every frame, typically in _process(): the [code]FmodManager[/code] autoload does it. Calling it again right after a request that must be heard as soon as possible hands that request to FMOD at once instead of at the next frame.

method.name: wait_for_all_loads
method.description: Blocks until all pending asynchronous operations have completed.
